title: SNMP — Device Faceplate
description: Tier 2: SolarWinds-style port faceplate for one switch. Use Site + Device controls. Demo: hq-access-sw-03 Eth1/4 oper-down; nyc-sw-02 Eth1/3 admin-down.

config.title: Device
config.esql_query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND host.type == "switch" AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS c = COUNT() BY host.name | SORT host.name | KEEP host.name

data_source.query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT() | EVAL `Selected device` = 1

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth1/") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY interface.name | WHERE oper == "up" | STATS `Ports up` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth1/") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY interface.name | WHERE oper == "down" | STATS `Ports down` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth1/") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp) BY interface.name | WHERE admin == "down" | STATS `Admin down` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth1/") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY interface.name | EVAL port_num = TO_INTEGER(REPLACE(interface.name, "Eth1/", "")) | EVAL row = CASE(port_num <= 12, "R1 Eth1/1-12", "R2 Eth1/13-24") | EVAL col = CASE(port_num <= 12, port_num, port_num - 12) | EVAL status_code = CASE(admin == "down", 0, oper == "down", 1, 2) | KEEP row, col, status_code, interface.name | SORT row, col

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS site = LAST(network.site, @timestamp), role = LAST(network.role, @timestamp), vendor = LAST(observer.vendor, @timestamp), model = LAST(observer.sys_descr, @timestamp), mgmt_ip = LAST(host.ip, @timestamp) BY host.name

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND `interface.traffic.in.bytes` IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS in_bytes = SUM(`interface.traffic.in.bytes`), out_bytes = SUM(`interface.traffic.out.bytes`) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 30, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND `interface.errors.in` IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS errors = SUM(COALESCE(`interface.errors.in`, 0) + COALESCE(`interface.errors.out`, 0)) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 30, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: All ports — admin / oper / traffic / errors

data_source.query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE host.name == ?device AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp), speed = LAST(interface.speed, @timestamp), in_bytes = LAST(`interface.traffic.in.bytes`, @timestamp), out_bytes = LAST(`interface.traffic.out.bytes`, @timestamp), in_err = LAST(`interface.errors.in`, @timestamp), out_err = LAST(`interface.errors.out`, @timestamp) BY interface.name | SORT interface.name

config.content: **Navigate:** [← Site Detail](#/view/snmp-tier1-site-detail) · [US Sites Overview](#/view/snmp-tier0-us-map) — green=up, red=oper-down, dark=admin-down on the faceplate heatmap.
